title: The cubric.studio/flows redirects - the app's Get-it buttons must reach the paid Gumroad pages
description: The two paid Flows are advertised INSIDE the app (MPI-831 phase 4, shipped f31d7377). Their Get-it buttons open https://cubric.studio/flows/head-swap and https://cubric.studio/flows/drama-box, which must REDIRECT to the coded Gumroad product URLs. Those redirects do not exist, so the shipped buttons currently 404 on our own domain. Website work: c:\AI\Mpi\Cubric Studio (Website). Blocks 2.0 - it is link 4 of the four-link chain in MPI-595 Gate A. The coded URL is deliberately NEVER in the app: the first-100-free offer code rides in that URL and Cubric-Vision is public AGPL, so a committed code could be spent to zero by people who never open the app; the redirect also lets the code be retired without shipping an app release. The two coded URLs come from MadPony-Identity MPI-81, which is Fabio-only (Gumroad has no write API).
